rationale: Describes real-time RAN data analysis, enrichment and correlation with subscriber and device data, and map visualization; the 'advanced geolocation algorithm' is not described as learned or AI-based, so the non-AI label is supported.
evidence_spans: TrueCall® is a software solution that provides real-time, 24x7x365 analysis of data originating in the radio access network (RAN).
The data is enriched using TrueCall’s advanced geolocation algorithm, and correlated with subscriber and device data.
